newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault aims for more foreign sales.
newsitem.headline: Renault aims for more foreign sales.

text.p: French auto maker Renault expects higher market share in foreign countries next year, Commercial Director Philippe Gamba said on Wednesday.
In an interview with Reuters Financial Television, Gamba said he expected Renault's domestic market share to be nearly unchanged next year.
"This year we feel that the Renault market share will be basically the same figure as last year on the French market, maybe a little bit more," Gamba said.
"But outside France this market share will be 0.5 more than last year. The idea is to depend less on the French market."
He said that at the end of June foreign sales represented 69 percent of the company's unit sales with the remainder in France.
